title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Due-and-Payable Notice, Options Letter and Response Deadline
content:
## Notices when the loan is called due

A due-and-payable notice and a successor options letter go to each recipient named by the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases plan:

- on the day the loan is called due, and in no case later than the plan's notice period after it;
- by the plan's delivery method.

The options letter lists the plan's intent options and the response window.

For a Cedarline Summit loan's case reclassified to the death of the last surviving borrower, and only for such a case:

- the two notices go to each successor in interest of the deceased borrower by first-class and certified mail;
- the options letter lists the death plan's intent options and the successor response window.

## Response deadline

When the loan is called due, the case's response deadline is the plan's successor response days, counted in calendar days after that day, because the due-and-payable notice is sent the same day.

For a Summit loan's case reclassified to the death of the last surviving borrower, and only for such a case, the response deadline becomes the mailing date of the successor's notices plus the successor response window.

## Once per date

Each notice type goes to each recipient once per date. For the successor's due-and-payable notice and options letter on a Summit loan's case reclassified to the death of the last surviving borrower, and only for that pair:

- the two notices go together to each successor once per date;
- the pair is identified by the case and the successor.

## When the successor's notices go out

The successor's due-and-payable notice and options letter are not mailed, and the successor response window is not counted, until the case's event type is the death of the last surviving borrower.

| Case | Who receives the two notices | Response deadline |
|---|---|---|
| any case called due | each recipient the plan names | the plan's successor response days after the call-due day |
| Summit loan case reclassified to the death of the last surviving borrower | each successor in interest of the deceased borrower | the mailing date plus the successor response window |

## Mailing the successor's notices: `mail_successor_due_notices_bb6e23d7`

**Capability.** One call does two things:

- records a due-and-payable notice and a successor options letter addressed to one successor in interest, both dated today;
- sets the case's response deadline to today's date moved later by the response window days supplied.

The case history lookup then shows both notices for the recipient, and the case lookup shows the new response deadline.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `mail_successor_due_notices_bb6e23d7` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `maturity_case_id` | reference number of the maturity case the notices concern, from the maturity case lookup | identifier |
| `recipient_customer_id` | customer reference number of the successor in interest the notices are addressed to, from the customer lookup | identifier |
| `response_window_days` | whole number of calendar days from today's date to the successor's response deadline | integer of 1 or more, no unit text, no decimals |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with these fields:

- `maturity_case_id`;
- `recipient_customer_id`;
- `notice_references`, the references of the due-and-payable notice entry and of the options letter entry;
- `mailing_date`, today's date;
- `response_deadline`, the case's resulting deadline.

A receipt with two notice references means both notices are recorded as mailed. An unknown case reference returns an error naming it.
